title: UPSC Geo Scientist Mains Result 2026
vacancyDetails: Candidates shortlisted for Interview/Personality Test for Geologist, Geophysicist, Chemist and related posts
qualification: Master’s degree in Geology / Geophysics / Chemistry / related disciplines as per post in UPSC CGSE rules
ageLimit: 21 to 32 years (post-wise variations & relaxations as per UPSC rules)
selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination → Main Examination → Personality Test / Interview → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Original certificates of age, qualification, community, disability; e-Summon for interview
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.upsc.gov.in
2. Download Combined Geo-Scientist (Main) Exam 2026 Result PDF
3. Search your Roll Number
4. Update DAF / details if required on upsconline.nic.in
5. Await interview schedule and e-Summon Letter
shortDescription: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist (Main) Exam 2026 result declared on 20 July 2026. Mains held on 20–21 June 2026; interview shortlist out on upsc.gov.in.
content:
The Union Public Service Commission has declared the result of the Combined Geo-Scientist (Main) Examination, 2026.

The Main Examination was held on 20 and 21 June 2026. Candidates with listed Roll Numbers have qualified for the Personality Test / Interview.

Candidature is provisional subject to eligibility. Check upsc.gov.in and upsconline.nic.in regularly for interview programme and document instructions.
